caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a seated cat figurine positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The face of the cat has distinct black outlines around the eyes and snout, with small hints of red at the nose and mouth, as well as red coloring on the inner portions of the ears and a faint reddish collar around its neck. The body is smooth with some patchy, darker spots to indicate texture or markings, and the paws are detailed with subtle lines. The overall composition is simple, with the figurine being the only object and occupying the majority of the space in the image.
